MIND. [1] [Arum. t.]
Great delirium. θ Scarlatina. θ Typhus.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arum. t.]
Quivering of left upper lid.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arum. t.]
Nose stopped up, < left side, must breathe through mouth, < mornings.
Sneezing ; < at night.
Fluent coryza, acrid.
Acrid ichorous discharge, excoriating inside of nose, the alæ and upper lips. θ Scarlatina.
Drink passes up through nose.
Nose feels stopped up in spite of watery discharge. θ Scarlatina.
He can only breathe with mouth open. θ Scarlatina.
Nose stopped, with or without profuse yellow discharge.
Nostrils sore, < left ; nose, lips and face chapped, as from a cold wind.
Constant picking at nose until it bleeds.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Arum. t.]
Swollen, bloated face. θ Scarlatina.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Arum. t.]
Lips as if scalded, mornings.
Lips burning, swollen, cracked and bleeding.
Picks lips until they bleed, corners of mouth sore, cracked and bleeding. θ Scarlatina.
Children will often pick and bore into raw surfaces, though doing so gives great pain, and they scream with it, but keep up boring. θ Scarlatina.
Appearance of raw, bloody surfaces, on lips, buccal cavity, nose, etc., with great itching. θ Scarlatina.
Swelling of submaxillary and parotid glands, left < θ Scarlatina.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Arum. t.]
Tongue cracked and bleeding.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arum. t.]
Excessive salivation ; saliva acrid. θ Scarlatina.
The mouth burns and is sore that they refuse to drink, and cry when anything is offered. θ Scarlatina. θ Diphtheria.
Buccal cavity raw and bleeding.
Great sore feeling in mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Cavity of mouth covered with diphtheritic deposit and ulcers. θ Diphtheritis.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arum. t.]
Refuses food and drink on account of soreness of throat. θ Scarlatina.
Putrid sore throat.
Throat and tongue very sore, burning pains, putrid ulcers in throat. θ Scarlatina.
Swelling of glands on throat and neck.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Arum. t.]
Children lose their appetite, don't want to play, lose flesh, have headache and scanty urine.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arum. t.]
Voice hoarse ; also from overexertion of voice in speaking or singing.
Voice uncertain, uncontrollable, changing continually ; now deep, hollow, then scarcely audible, and again high, shrieking.
Clergyman's sore throat ; hoarseness, < from talking.
Accumulation of mucus in trachea.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Arum. t.]
Pain through left lung, about base of heart.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Arum. t.]
Sleeplessness from soreness of mouth and throat, or from itching of skin.
   

FEVER. [40] [Arum. t.]
Typhoid forms of fever ; picking ends of fingers and dry lips till they bleed ; boring nose ; restless tossing about bed, wants to escape ; unconscious of what he is doing or of what is said to him ; urine suppressed ; great weakness (last stages probably with uræmia).
   

SKIN. [46] [Arum. t.]
Itching with desquamation, following a scarlet rash.
Eruption all over body, with much itching and restlessness. θ Scarlatina.
Desquamation a second or third time, in large flakes, in scarlatina.
Scarlatina, when characteristic symptoms of nose, mouth and throat (See 7, 12, 13) are present ; fever very intense ; in one case rawness down inner side of thighs.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arum. t.]
Clergymen, orators', singers', actors', auctioneers' sore throat ; even the highest potencies, one drop, have restored the voice in a few hours.
